features: Large Size & Capacity – Our over the door organizer is made of breathable, durable, and low-odor non-woven fabric. With 5 roomy pockets (14.5 x 6.5 x 6.5 in) and 4.5 in spacing, this over the door organizer provides ample storage for different items, supporting up to 20KG.

Stable & Well-Structured – Designed with stitched sides and reinforced cardboard on the front, sides, and bottom, this door organizer hanging maintains its shape and is less likely to deform or tilt when fully loaded.

10 Mesh Side Pockets – The wall hanging storage organizer comes with 10 extra mesh pockets (6.5 x 6.5 in) for small items like chargers, remotes, glasses, keys, or cosmetics, making access more convenient.
Clear PVC Window – Each pocket of the door hanging storage organizer includes a visible PVC window, allowing you to check contents at a glance and keep belongings organized.

Wide Application – This foldable over the door hanging storage bag with 2 metal hooks fits doors under 2.0 in. Suitable for bedrooms, nurseries, bathrooms, laundry rooms, dorms, and offices to store toys, diapers, towels, socks, cosmetics, or hair tools.
